data.title: ‘Highly experimental!’ — Analysts split on new proposal for private Bitcoin transfers
data.description:
Bitcoin could have Zcash-style private transfers without making any changes to the network’s consensus layer. 

According to researchers led by Clara Shikheman, the private transfers can be achieved by leveraging the mixer logic used by Tornado Cash.

In other words, the proposal could allow one to plug BTC into a private encrypted note. It can then be transferred around using ZK (zero-knowledge) proofs, which shield the sender, receiver, and the amount being moved. At the exit point, you’re assigned a new address. 

Commenting on the update, Clara Shikheman, head of Bitcoin-focused research firm Alloc Init, said, 

No soft forks, no bridges, no operators, just Bitcoin. We’ve put a lot of work into thinking carefully about the security of Shielded Bitcoin and about what information the protocol reveals. And this is just the beginning!

For his part, Eli Ben-Sasson, founder of Starknet and one of the pioneers of ZK proofs, hailed the move. He noted, 

I love this direction; our original intent with Zerocash paper (the whitepaper preceding Zcash) was to bring privacy to Bitcoin. I would love to see our vision of privacy and scalability via ZK materialize on Bitcoin L1.

Will it resolve Bitcoin’s privacy problem?

For the unfamiliar, public blockchains, to some extent, only offer an illusion of privacy. By design, they are open ledgers. As such, anyone with an Internet connection can track every transaction and fund balance in on-chain wallets.  

To some, this is a deal-breaker. This is why some Bitcoin OGs jumped to Zcash because it had shielded pools. Of course, some criminal elements would opt for such private features. However, it’s not all about bad guys or fraudsters. 

Imagine paying for a $3 coffee, swiping your debit card, and the shop attendant instantly gets your card and bank details, fund balances, and historical transactions. This can elevate on-chain and physical security threats.

In fact, kidnappings and wrench attacks against crypto investors have spiked because of data breaches. The lack of privacy features across public blockchains can exacerbate these risks. So, private Bitcoin transfers can be a game changer. 

According to researcher Robin Linus though, the approach this proposal uses is still far from being verified and battle-tested. 

It’s worth emphasizing that the cryptography underlying this approach is still highly experimental, and its security assumptions are far from established.

Additionally, some argue that the approach is not quantum-secure. Overall, it’s great to see the push to make Bitcoin transfers private despite the fact that it may take a little while for it to become a reality. 

Final Summary

  • Researchers propose Zcash-style Bitcoin private transfers that do not require changing the consensus layer. 
  • However, critics warn that the approach is not verified and may come with additional risks.

data.title: Brazil targets self-custody crypto with $10K reporting rule, 24-hour transfer delay
data.description:
Brazil crypto rules are set to get tougher in Q4 2025 and get even stricter from next year. 

The Central Bank of Brazil’s order this week formally expands reporting requirements for crypto transfers above $10K across self-custody wallets. 

Here, it’s worth noting that the new reporting regime is not strictly on crypto transfers. Any payments or funds transfers via foreign exchange or local cash above R$50,000.00 (about $10K) must be reported. 

In the statement, the Central Bank of Brazil said the move is aimed at “preventing the use of the financial system for money laundering, concealment of assets or financing of terrorism.” The rule will be effective from 1st October. 

However, the scrutiny over crypto assets has intensified. 

Brazil imposes 24-hour delay for crypto transfers

Last month, Brazil imposed a mandatory 24-hour delay for crypto transfers. According to the country’s central bank, the move is aimed at minimizing harm to victims of fraud, while also helping law enforcement rein in anti-money laundering (AML) or illicit flows. 

It argued that the instant settlement nature of crypto transfers makes it challenging to catch fraudsters and block illicit flows in time. The rule will go into effect in January 2027. 

The surprising part, however, is the country’s plan to integrate with the European instant payment system. 

In other words, the two are fast-tracking an interconnected Brazil and Euro-area public payment system for fast transfers. And yet, it will throttle crypto transfers to act as an anti-fraud and crime buffer to catch the so-called “money launderers.”

Interestingly, the U.K, Australia, and Singapore also have a similar buffer system with a 24-72 hour delay for outbound and inbound transfers to risky crypto platforms.

The EU, however, relies on the Travel Rule, which mandates crypto exchanges to stop and verify cross-border transfers before clearing them. In fact, this is the model that Bulgaria and Thailand have adopted, and they all touch on self-custody transfers. 

The Travel Rule is being widely pushed globally by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), the international agency that formulates AML and anti-terrorist financing rules. 

Overall, crypto’s partial anonymity will be aggressively fought from 2027 amid coordinated global AML pressure. 

Final Summary

  • Brazil will enforce reporting for +$10K crypto transfers across self-custody wallets from October.
  • It will also impose a 24-hour mandatory crypto transfer delay as an anti-fraud and crime buffer.

data.title: Why is Backpack [BP] crypto up? RWA rebound, 73x short liquidations & more…
data.description:
Backpack [BP] rallied more than 43% in the past 24 hours, bringing its weekly gains above 121%. During this period, the price of BP went on to make a new peak value of about $1.3994.

Even in trends, BP led all other coins in social sentiment. Other factors that contributed to this sharp uptick in price were volume and total assets deployed.

Analyzing resurgence in RWA-themed coins

First, there was a market-wide resurgence in the real-world asset (RWA) sector, with BP leading all in daily gains, according to CoinGecko. Other RWA-themed coins that came close were Ondo Finance [ONDO] and Quant [QNT], of which both grew over 25%.

The uptrend was amplified by a spike in perpetual liquidations of shorts, which was 73 times bigger than that of longs.

Further analysis of the protocol, which is built on Solana [SOL], unmasked more metrics.

For instance, Total Assets deployed on BP reached a new high of $604.75 million. Over the past week, the average daily asset transfer count reached 1 million.

As a result, asset holders surged by 204%, surpassing the 242K mark, as per Token Terminal.

Additionally, the monthly token trading volume surged by 175%, to about $157 million. But from a daily perspective, the volume had quadrupled from $7 million to over $29 million.

However, its monthly DEX trading volume declined by 12%, even though it remained high at $1.10 billion.

What’s next for BP after printing a new high?

On the charts, BP was respecting a rising trendline support over the past 8 days. In fact, the altcoin was trading above $1, but bulls were potentially losing grip.

The Bull Bear Power (BBP) reinforced this declining buyer momentum. Even the Chaikin Money Flow (CMF) indicated capital was leaving the coin. The CMF indicator plunged from 0.40 to negative 0.08.

This data explains why BP appears to be entering a correction phase. If the altcoin retraces to the slanting support, it would align with the 0.786-0.90 Fibonacci Retracement level.

Still, traders should be wary of BP equalling its peak value at $1.3994 before an actual retracement. But that is not certain, as there were aggressive sellers above $1.30. The trend was clearly evident as candles were closing at or below this level with a lot of wicks above.

These multiple wicks above $1.30 indicated selling pressure in this zone.

Final Summary

  • Backpack rallied over 43% in the past 24 hours and hit a new high amid a resurgence in the broader RWA sector. 
  • BP was respecting a rising trendline support, but capital was flowing out after the new peak.

data.title: XRP ETF inflows hit $38M — Can price break the $1.60 barrier?
data.description:
US spot XRP exchange-traded funds saw around $38 million in two trading sessions, showing a fresh sign of investor demand.

XRP has also recovered to around the $1.56 price level, but it has yet to overcome selling pressure near the $1.60 price level. It must overcome this level before the latest rise it is seeing can develop into a stronger one.

Bitwise leads latest XRP ETF inflows

XRP ETFs saw $14.89 million in net inflows on September 24, according to SoSoValue data. This was after it saw around $23.17 million in the previous session, bringing the two-day total to just over $38 million.

Bitwise’s fund led the latest daily inflows with $9.91 million. Franklin Templeton followed with $4.98 million, while no net movement could be seen from the other listed products.

The five funds now hold a combined $1.70 billion in assets. Their cumulative net inflows have reached $1.76 billion.

Bitwise’s XRP holdings have also grown. The fund held 401.42 million tokens on September 23, which is up by 14.18 million from two days earlier.

Its XRP was worth about $613.89 million, according to Bitwise’s official fund page.

XRP price faces its next test at $1.60

XRP traded near the $1.56 price level at the time of this writing, having gained about 2% during the session.

The price has recovered from its recent dip, and it remains above the levels that have supported its rebound. Buyers have also returned, and they have done this with stronger trading activity.

The next challenge now sits around the $1.60 price level. It has approached this area on different occasions, but sellers have not allowed it to hold above that level.

A convincing move through the $1.60–$1.65 price region would show that buyers remain in control. It could also give XRP room to extend its recovery.

For now, the $1.50 price level is the nearest level to watch if the price drops. If it holds above it, this would help it to preserve the short-term momentum.

If it falls below the $1.50 level, it would make the recovery less convincing and could bring the price back towards the $1.43 price area.

Final Summary

  • XRP ETFs attracted approximately $38 million over two trading sessions.
  • XRP has recovered to $1.56 but still faces resistance between $1.60 and $1.65.

data.title: Ondo surges 26% as BlackRock tokenization push expands – But THIS risk suggests…
data.description:
Ondo price pumped 26.73% after BlackRock-powered portfolios expanded its tokenization push, as its spot volume surged 276.89% amid the breakout.

Recently, Ondo Finance introduced three Ondo Intelligent Portfolios utilizing portfolio strategies developed by BlackRock specifically for the protocol. These products provided professionally constructed investment strategies directly on-chain vie single transferable assets.

More importantly, the launch expanded Ondo’s tokenization proposition beyond creating access to individual real-world assets. In fact, investors could instead gain exposure to the diversified strategies through exchanges, wallets, and compatible DeFi applications.

Additionally, the development also reinforced Ondo’s institutional outlook since BlackRock supplied the underlying portfolio strategies. 

Meanwhile, the token’s rapid price response implied traders quickly responded to the broadened tokenization offering.

Spot buyers take control of the rally

Elsewhere, the ONDO’s Spot Taker CVD metric highlighted that taker buyers dominated as the token price increased. Therefore, aggressive bulls absorbed the available spot supply as ONDO pushed through several key resistance levels.

This positioning hence complemented the 276.89% spot volume increase during the rapid price expansion. The higher volume implied considerably greater participation, accompanying ONDO’s 26.73% price advance.

Crucially, the taker-buy dominance meant traders actively crossed the spread to secure ONDO. Hence, the spot profile provided a stronger demand beneath the BlackRock-driven outlook.

Subsequently, Ondo price pushed beyond the $0.4083 and $0.4613 price levels before challenging the higher $ 0.5201 resistance.

Can $0.5201 unlock the next leg?

At the time of writing, ONDO traded around $0.5361 after breaking the $0.5201 resistance, placing the token above its previous resistance structure. 

Notably on the daily timeframe chart, the price breakout provided a technical route towards the $0.6000 level in case buyers maintain control above the $0.5201 support.

The technical MACD indicator confirmed the bullish price setup as it sat above its signal line. The MACD’s positive histogram also rose to 0.0165, highlighting stronger directional pressure during the rapid move.

However, the RSI indicator on the other hand climbed to 73.24, pushing beyond the conventional 70 overbought conditions threshold. 

Even so, the reading did not invalidate the price breakout, although it increased the vulnerability to a short-term cooling.

Therefore, a controlled retest of the $0.5201 support could introduce a crucial test for fresh demand. And also holding this support zone would preserve the breakout structure, keeping $0.6000 within reach.

Lower liquidity puts $0.48 in play

The 24-hour Binance Liquidation Heatmap introduced another consideration around ONDO’s elevated price. Notably, dense liquidity clusters accumulated around the $0.48 level, well below the token’s most active trading region.

Further liquidity clusters could also be seen between nearly $0.45 and $0.48, creating several potential downside liquidity pulls.  A weakening demand above the $0.5201 area could therefore accelerate the attraction of those lower clusters.

Noteworthy, the overbought RSI made that scenario particularly relevant following ONDO’s rapid price rally. The spot taker buying however remained a crucial counterweight since aggressive buyers still dominated after the expansion.

As a result, the $0.5201 area now separates continuation from a potentially deeper liquidity-driven pullback. 

Final Summary

  • BlackRock-powered portfolios strengthened ONDO’s rally as aggressive spot buyers supported the breakout.
  • ONDO’s breakout targets $0.60, although lower liquidity could draw price toward $0.48.

data.title: Grayscale’s Zcash ETF hits $1B AUM, but fresh inflows tell a different story
data.description:
In a surprising turn of events, Grayscale’s Zcash ETF (ZCSH) hit $1 billion in assets under management (AUM) on 24th September.

However, this does not mean investors have poured $1 billion of new money into the fund. Instead, only $306.12 million was poured in as cumulative net inflows. In other words, less than one-third of its current value came from new investor money.

The reality behind the $1 billion AUM

Still, this is a very noteworthy development, as after the fund’s launch on 25th August, it surpassed $500 million in assets in just two weeks. And now, it has reached the $1 billion-AUM threshold, effectively doubling its reported assets in about 16 days.

However, this surge in momentum was not just driven by fresh investor inflows. Instead, it was fueled also by Zcash’s [ZEC] sharp price hike and the fund’s pre-existing ZEC holdings inherited from the Grayscale Zcash Trust.

For those unaware, ZCSH got converted from the older Grayscale Zcash Trust, which had already been holding a large amount of ZEC since 2017. And therefore, it goes without saying that those existing ZEC holdings were simply carried into the ETF structure.

All about ZEC’s price action

At the same time, ZEC’s price has roughly doubled since the ETF began trading, increasing the dollar value of the ZEC the fund already owned. This, in turn, has pushed its AUM higher, without requiring equivalent new purchases.

In fact, at press time, ZEC was trading at $1,533 after a hike of 92% in the past 30 days.

These developments coincided with Europe’s launch of the first physically-backed Zcash ETP by 21Shares.

Movements in the broader ETF space

The broader crypto ETF market highlighted positive investor sentiment during the week ending on 24th September.

Bitcoin [BTC] ETFs attracted the most capital, recording $2.25 billion in inflows, while Ethereum [ETH] ETFs followed with $602.94 million.

Meanwhile, XRP ETFs brought in $52.95 million, Solana [SOL] ETFs attracted $101.55 million, and Hyperliquid [HYPE] ETFs recorded $6.02 million in inflows.

Final Summary

  • Within two week of the launch, Grayscale’s Zcash ETF surpassed $500 million in AUM. 
  • Other ETFs, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and smaller altcoins, all recorded inflows over the past week.

data.title: BlackRock snags 1.97K BTC as inflows hit 6 days: Why Bitcoin’s $87K remains out of reach
data.description:
Bitcoin’s pullback from $87k seems to have not negatively impacted institutional investors’ sentiment. In fact, BTC Spot ETFs have recorded net inflow for six consecutive sessions. 

BlackRock’s IBIT adds $166 million as  inflows extend to 6 sessions 

Onchain Lens reported that BlackRock’s IBIT accumulated 1.97K BTC worth $166 million from Coinbase Prime.

BlackRock’s IBIT has been aggressively accumulating. AMBCrypto earlier reported that the fund recorded over $1 billion in Inflows for four consecutive sessions. 

Even after Bitcoin [BTC] dropped to $82k, investors continued to get exposure through the ETF. That said, BlackRock’s spree is not an isolated case. As this is a part of broader renewed demand from other ETFs.

In as much, BTC Spot ETFs have recorded net inflows for six consecutive sessions between September 17th and 24th. These funds recorded a total of $2.8 billion in inflows over the period. 

The continued net inflows suggest that ETFs have jumped in even to buy the dips. In doing so, they absorbed market pressure. 

In fact , on September 24th trading session, only WisdomTree’s (BTCW) recorded outflows, seeing $4 million in net outflows. This points to strong optimism, with investors expecting the trend to hold. 

With these funds buying, they have pulled a significant share of supply on Exchanges. As a result, Exchange Netflow has remained negative for four consecutive days , coinciding ETFs inflows. 

Historically, since ETFs came around in 2024, strong periods of net inflows have preceded better price performances on BTC charts.

One major hurdle remains for Bitcoin

Bitcoin ETFs are now buying, which gives hope for the market. But it does not mean all institutions are buying. US institutional investors remain adamant and , with the majority dumping.

A look at Bitcoin’s Coinbase Premium Index, the metric has remained negative for three consecutive days. At press time, CPI sat around -0.02. 

With the index holding negative, it suggest most institutional investors are yet to start buying, while other cash out recent gains.

Previously, Bitcoin has relied on both ETFs recording net inflows, and Coinbase Premium index positive. We cannot confirm the transition into a bullish phase until, the two holds true.

Until then, Bitcoin will continue to fluctuate, with every uptick, followed by a pullback, as the stability lacks on this side. If it happens so, BTC will be strong enough to reclaim $87k, flip $90k, and eye to extend the rally.

Final summary

  • BlackRock’s IBIT purchased 1.97K BTC worth $166 million  as ETFs recorded net inflows for six consecutive sessions. 
  • Bitcoin’s Coinbase Premium Index still remains negative, suggesting institutions are not fully convinced.

data.title: Assessing DeepBook’s 12% rally amid $23M in market activity
data.description:
DeepBook [DEEP] gained 12% as its combined Spot and Perpetual Volume surged more than 77% to roughly $23 million.

The rise brought more traders into the market. However, CoinGlass data showed whales and retail traders leaning bullish while Smart Money took an “Extremely Bearish” position.

Why are DEEP traders divided?

CoinGlass recorded Long/Short Ratio readings of 2.12 for retail traders and 1.12 for whales. Both readings of DeepBook [DEEP] pointed to a bullish lean within those groups.

Smart Money traders, meanwhile, took the opposite side. Their “Extremely Bearish” reading raised a question about how much support DEEP’s rally had across market participants.

That disagreement matters more than the label itself. The next set of market-wide readings showed a narrower bullish edge.

What did DEEP’s Funding Rate show?

Across the tracked trading venues, longs accounted for 50.7% of volume, against 49.3% for shorts. Buyers held an edge, but only a small one.

By contrast, the Funding Rate of DeepBook [DEEP] turned negative at -0.0027%. That reading showed a bearish tilt in Perpetual pricing, despite DEEP’s price gain.

The Funding Rate had also dipped below zero on the 14th and 23rd of September before returning to positive territory. Those earlier reversals leave room for another rebound, though they do not establish that a short squeeze will follow.

For now, DEEP’s rally has buyers behind it, but conviction remains uneven. Whether the Funding Rate recovers may help show if the disagreement is fading.

Final Summary

  • DeepBook rose 12% as Spot and Perpetual Volume increased, while retail traders and whales leaned bullish.
  • Smart Money stayed bearish, and a negative Funding Rate complicated the case for another move higher.

data.title: ICP crypto tests 2024 trendline as bulls target $3.23 breakout
data.description:
On Wednesday, September 23, Bitcoin [BTC] saw a brief pullback from $87.3k that sent the leading crypto down to $82.9k. This dip has since begun to recover.

Internet Computer [ICP] did not see much of a price dip in recent days, and has pushed higher by 7.1% in the past 24 hours. Its Open Interest was up by 8.4% in 24 hours, too, signaling bullish short-term conviction amongst speculators.

The spot CVD has not begun to recover despite the price gains, and the funding rate was in negative territory. It indicated that the majority of derivatives market participants were leaning bearishly and expecting a local top.

This might set up the conditions for a short squeeze in the coming days. Can this propel ICP crypto beyond the June highs?

ICP crypto’s monthly trendline breach shows bullish intent

On the monthly chart, there was a trendline resistance level [dotted white] that has been tested thrice since 2024. A monthly session close above this trendline has not occurred in nearly three years.

With just five days left for the monthly close, it appeared unlikely that ICP crypto would fail to beat the trendline by falling back below $2.15.

However, the higher timeframe price chart highlighted the persistent downtrend.

Traders’ call to action- Stay bullish

ICP crypto is beginning to do well, but it would still be extremely difficult to beat the long-term downtrend. The altcoin is down 99.58% from its $750 all-time high and has a market cap of $1.77 billion.

Nevertheless, ICP has managed to trend higher since August. The $2.40 and $2.62 resistance levels have been breached. The move past $2.4 flipped the daily swing structure bullishly.

From there, combined with the recent crypto market-wide enthusiasm, ICP crypto has managed to rally to the late-May highs around $3.20.

A daily session close above $3.23 would signal a bullish continuation, but swing traders and investors should also be prepared for a pullback toward $2.61-$2.75.

Final Summary

  • ICP crypto has been a consistently bullish performer since August, rallying 60.4% in just under two months.
  • The $3.20 supply zone was being tested, and another breakout could be possible, given the strong demand behind the altcoin.

data.title: QNT surges 38% as Quant’s institutional adoption deepens – 3 signals to watch
data.description:
Quant ecosystem entered a stronger market phase after institutional developments extended its role across regulated tokenized payment infrastructure in key financial markets.

Recently, Quant was selected by the Clearing House for its On-Chain Money Initiative before the token’s recent rally unfolded. Reportedly, the network handles approximately $2 trillion in daily U.S. payments.

Additionally, U.K. banks also completed live customer transactions, including tokenized sterling deposits through Quant’s ecosystem. These developments combined reinforced Quant’s institutional adoption picture before investors repriced QNT aggressively.

Subsequently, the token rallied 38%, while its spot trading volume climbed 228.9% to nearly $38.2 million. Similar activity was also reflected in the derivatives markets, where leverage accelerated much faster.

Fresh leverage floods into QNT

In particular, the derivatives participants drastically increased their exposure as QNT price pushed higher alongside the growing spot participation.

Furthermore, the corresponding derivatives volume also climbed 637.49% to $214.37 million, considerably exceeding the expansion recorded across the spot markets. 

Notably, QNT’s Open Interest also pumped 78.87% to $29.54 million as investors opened fresh leveraged positions.

The overall Long/Short Ratio stood at 1.0483, leaving the positioning slightly tilted towards the longs. 

Additionally, the liquidations, however, revealed greater pressure on market participants betting against the rally.

Specifically, the short liquidations hit $439.43K during 24 hours, with only $65.67K across the long positions. The forced short closures therefore likely amplified buying during QNT’s sharp price rally.

However, this derivatives expansion also elevated QNT’s sensitivity to sudden price swings. 

Spot demand meets growing supply pressure

The Spot Taker CVD remained buyer-dominant as the aggressive buyers continued protecting QNT price advance. 

On the other hand, the futures Taker CVD remained seller-dominant, implying resistance from the leveraged market participants.

Therefore, this divergence separated the underlying spot demand from the more cautious positioning visible across the futures markets.

The exchange reserves meanwhile jumped 39.49% to nearly $112 million in 24 hours, placing considerably more QNT within exchange wallets as the rally unfolded.

The higher exchange reserves introduced a potential sell-side supply in case holders move tokens onto exchanges for distribution. However, the buyer-dominant spot activity had absorbed pressure as QNT price pushed higher.

Eventually, sustaining the demand could become crucial as price approaches a major technical barrier.

Can QNT clear its next barrier?

The weekly technical price structure changed considerably following the recent price advance. 

On the charts, Quant [QNT] broke above its prolonged descending channel, reclaiming the $80.53 price level. This breakout marked an important shift from its previous weekly structure.

Subsequently, the price surged towards the $102.91 resistance area, with QNT reaching $98.65 at the time of the press. 

Notably, the RSI indicator rose to 68.16 during the breakout, approaching overbought territory but not yet crossing the 70 threshold.

Additionally, the directional positioning also changed sharply with DMI showing the +DI signal at 35.29, substantially above the -DI signal at 13.63.

The ADX indicator, however, remained lower at 12.73, leaving room for a stronger trend confirmation despite the broadening directional gap. 

Therefore, the $102.91 price level became the next test for buyers following the channel breakout.

Ultimately, a strong breakout could expose the $131.77 level as the next key resistance while a rejection could return QNT towards $80.53 support for a breakout retest.

Final Summary

  • Institutional payment adoption provided QNT’s catalyst, while spot buyers supported the resulting rally.
  • Rising exchange reserves and futures selling could challenge QNT’s breakout near $102.91.
